Subject: Your anticipatory bail matter - Anticipatory Bail Application No. 915/2022

Dear Ms. Tiwari,

Thank you for meeting us on 22 April 2022 about your dispute with Madhuri Shetty. As we understand it, the complaint alleges negligence during treatment. The matter is listed before the Warangal Sessions Court.

Our advice is to rely on the expert committee opinion that there was no gross negligence. Please collect the treatment records and the expert committee opinion and send copies to this office.

Regards,
Adv. Kunal Bhagat
